collection.description: An adult villager realizes they have romantic feelings for a friend of the same sex.

setup_m.name: The setup
setup_m.text: (men1), an adult villager, realizes they have romantic feelings for (men2) of the same sex.

a1_m.name: Outcome A1
a1_m.text: (men2) returns the affection, and they begin courting.

a2_m.name: Outcome A2
a2_m.text: (men2) does not share the feelings but responds warmly.

b2_m.name: Outcome B2
b2_m.text: They discover their bond feels more like family.

c2_m.name: Outcome C2
c2_m.text: (relative) listens thoughtfully and asks what support would help.

d1_m.name: Outcome D1
d1_m.text: (men1) becomes more certain of their feelings.

d2_m.name: Outcome D2
d2_m.text: (men1) decides no confession is needed to value the friendship.
